items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I used to play with him at the old folks home now when he was playing there.

ctx.x: Could you tell me something about other piano players who also played on fish fries, songs, violences and stuff.

Oh. Well, Deku used to play. This boy used to play. Boynton El Centiocho used to play. Fish fries. Right. But he was an early piano player. He learned how to play piano early when he died young. He was thirty years old when he died. I know, baby, when he got dope, you know. Oh boy. Well, I don't even smoke a good cigarette. Yeah, brother.
Do you smoke bad cigarettes? Huh? Do you smoke bad cigarettes? Who? You said you don't smoke good cigarettes? I don't smoke no kind of cigarettes. Oh, I'm sorry. No.

items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: INTERVIEWER: By the way, you know where Walter Deku is? Have you seen him lately? INTERVIEWEE: No, I don't know where he's at.

ctx.x: When did, when did you play a jumper that lasts, Fran? Huh? When did you play a jumper that lasts? About three cents a ago.

Three cents a ago? Mmhmm. Where? On a picnic. Oh yeah. Still, still working. Oh yeah, yeah. Well we played on that too. You know I got a friend of mine, you know, Riley. You know Riley, don't you? You mean Riley? Oh yeah. Well you see sometimes he gets a little miffed up and he sends me on his job at, well in fact it was my job. Yeah. I hired all the fellas in the turn around cause I used to let me slide. Yeah. And she fired me. But now when Riley wants to lay off, well then I go and play in his place until he…
By the way, you know where Walter Deku is? Have you seen him lately?
